reviews.title: Apple watch app is not good as garmin
reviews.text: Recently I switched to apple watch from Garmin. Udisc is the app that I use a lot but apple watch fail to satisfied my expectations. Cheap garmin show perfectly hole numbers on their watch. Somehow, iwatch is missing to up date every hole. It seems that, garmin download all holes of the course at first movement and filling score and apple watch is waiting for update every single hole through network and that is frustrating. The most disc golf course doesn't have good network.. Please fix it...

reviews.title: Does not work for Apple Watch
reviews.text: It does not let you keep score on Apple Watch. The developers lied to me saying it does. I have the Apple Watch Ultra and it does not let me keep score on it like they say. It just shows the “distance” and the option to open on iPhone. You sent me a message claiming it does and asked me to update my review. Well here’s my update. It does not let you track your score on Apple Watch.

reviews.title: Charged my account without authorization
reviews.text: Do not get this app!!! I put the app on my phone and did not get the Pro account because I was fine with the free version. A few days later my Apple account was charged around $32 without my authorization and without me ever signing up for the Pro version. Then it was impossible to contact someone from UDisc to resolve the issue. There is no place on their app or website for support. Do not get this app!!!

reviews.title: Leaderboard data wiped
reviews.text:
I had been using and paying for the app since 2015. I had a decade worth of leaderboard data for all the courses I have played. Now that I am on the free version you wipe all of my past existence from any leaderboard while I was paying for the app. Wtf. I understand not publishing any of my new rounds on the leaderboard but getting rid of all of the past rounds, when those rounds were played and recorded while paying for the app, makes no sense. 

Wish I didn’t have to give a terrible review for an app that has given me so much joy and usability for over a decade. This is not a sound business practice in mind.

reviews.title: Why did you jack with the discs part?!
reviews.text: I use UDisc to keep track of all my discs - in and out of my bag. The latest update completely messed it all up. In a pinch I could look at my list of discs in my bag and know a number - now when the in bag selection is on, instead of giving me the number of discs in my bag, it just says the total number of discs I have total. Then you went and took out the sort by speed option, so like a mental case, I have to look up discs alphabetically by name. Zero thought went into your last update where you just completely flipped the disc part on its head - almost like whoever did the update doesn’t even use it or even play disc golf. I usually rave about UDisc - until you put back the disc part like it was before, I’m looking for other app options to keep track of my disc inventory
